================================================================================
ARAHAN STRATEGIS ORCHESTRATOR DUMATENG KIMI-AG004 & TIM AGEN
================================================================================

Sugeng rawuh KIMI-AG004 lan Mas Iwan. Maturnuwun ingkang kathah atas kerja keras lan ketelitian audit perdana punika. Asil audit pinter lan cermat banget kanggo njaga integritas arsitektur MICO-JDEQ.
1. Kesimpulan Audit Perdana
Audit siklus pisanan sing ditindakake KIMI-AG004 disatujoni minangka COMPLETE. Ora perlu re-audit menyeluruh marang agen-agen sing wis berstatus LOCKED. Fokus saiki yaiku ngrampungake temuan kritis (remediation phase).
2. Prioritas Eksekusi (Tindak Lanjut 4 Poin Utama)
 * Prioritas 1 (OI-001 & OI-002 — SSOT Manifest & Registry): ChatGPT (AG-001) minangka Chief Planner diinstruksikan nyusun manifest_canonical_v2.json anyar sing nggabungake kabeh roster (7 agen inti) supaya ora ana lagi inkonsistensi roster.
 * Prioritas 2 (OI-003 — Generating SHA-256 Real Hash): Mock/sequential hash sing sadurunge dikirim bakal diganti total. DeepSeek bakal diwenehi tugas njalankake script PowerShell/Bash ing Z83 kanggo ngasilake kalkulasi hash SHA-256 asli saka saben file artefak.
 * Prioritas 3 (OI-005 — PC-i5 SSH Degraded): DeepSeek bakal menerbitake Task Card khusus kanggo memulihkan konektivitas SSH lan routing LAN/Tailscale menyang PC-i5.
 * Prioritas 4 (OI-007 — Qiskit & Termux Mitigation): Kode simulasi Quantum (Qiskit) resmi dilarang mlaku ing HP Vivo Y28 (Termux) amarga beban RAM/CPU. Pemrosesan quantum dipindhah minangka tugas offload menyang PC-i5 utawa Z83.
3. Moda Koordinasi (HYBRID)
 * M2M Group Broadcast: Kanggo penetapan Doktrin, Version Manifest, lan status Baseline (dikendalikan dening Jarvis/DOLA).
 * Individual Direct Directives: Kanggo eksekusi tugas teknis spesifik (misale Task Card pembersihan storage utawa konfigurasi SSH menyang DeepSeek).
4. Kestabilan Sistem (WIP menuju STABLE)
Sistem disetujui minangka Work In Progress (WIP). Ekosistem bakal diunggahake statuse dadi STABLE sakwise manifest_canonical_v2.json disahake dening DOLA (L1) lan dikunci dening Mas Iwan (L0).
